title: Multidimensional Szemerédi Theorem Bounds
exact_target: Obtain density thresholds controlled by a fixed finite number of logarithms for multidimensional arithmetic configurations, including squares and three-dimensional corners over finite fields, and fixed homothetic patterns in integer grids.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 108 (GREEN-020). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, author manuscript with December 2025 updates, Problem 20 and its comments, pp. 12--13.
